## if/elif/else

Clean conditionals with no parentheses required. Chained comparisons work: `0 < x < 10`.

## Loops

`for x in iterable` and `while`. Use `enumerate` for indices and `zip` to iterate in parallel. `break`, `continue`, and the rarely-used loop `else`.

## Structural pattern matching

`match/case` (Python 3.10+) destructures values and shapes — more than a switch.

blocks.code:
match command.split():
    case ["go", direction]:
        move(direction)
    case ["quit"]:
        stop()
    case _:
        print("unknown")
